name: Ginzburg-Landau
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
                                                                                          The complex Ginzburg-Landau equation describes a vast variety of phenomena from nonlinear 
waves to second-order phase transitions, from superconductivity, superfluidity, and 
Bose-Einstein condensation to liquid crystals and strings in field theory. 
<a href="http://hopf.chem.brandeis.edu/yanglingfa/pattern/cgle/index.html">
[link]</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Ginzburg-Landau" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="alpha">
        0.082
      </param>
      <param name="beta">
        0.8
      </param>
      <param name="delta">
        1.31
      </param>
      <param name="gamma">
        0.0799
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.375
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.0035
      </param>
      <param name="mag_amp">
        1.1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_power">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_zeroPt">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="mag_to_Da">
        -1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_to_Db">
        1.5
      </param>
      <param name="mag_to_gamma">
        0.5
      </param>
      <param name="wave_diffusion">
        0.0005
      </param>
      <param name="wave_damp">
        0.9991
      </param>
      <param name="wave_power">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="wave_clamp_min">
        -2
      </param>
      <param name="wave_clamp_max">
        2
      </param>
      <param name="a_to_wave">
        -0.0005
      </param>
      <param name="b_to_wave">
        0.0005
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_wave">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_a">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_b">
        0.04
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_alpha">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_beta">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_delta">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_gamma">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_Da">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_Db">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="a_to_history">
        -0.003
      </param>
      <param name="b_to_history">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_complement_prediv">
        0.08
      </param>
      <param name="complement_c_to_history">
        0.008
      </param>
      <param name="history_damp">
        0.012
      </param>
      <param name="history_diffusion">
        0.0004
      </param>
      <param name="history_pow">
        1.02
      </param>
      <param name="history_pow_norm">
        0.3
      </param>
      <param name="history_clamp_min">
        -1
      </param>
      <param name="history_clamp_max">
        1
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="6">
                delta_a = (c*mag_to_Da + d*wave_to_Da + D_a) * laplacian_a + (alpha + d*wave_to_alpha)*a - (gamma + c*mag_to_gamma + d*wave_to_gamma)*b + (-(beta + d*wave_to_beta)*a + (delta + d*wave_to_delta)*b)*(a*a+b*b) + d*wave_to_a;
delta_b = (c * mag_to_Db + d*wave_to_Db + D_b) * laplacian_b + (alpha + d*wave_to_alpha)*b + (gamma + c*mag_to_gamma + d*wave_to_gamma)*a + (-(beta + d*wave_to_beta)*b - (delta + d*wave_to_delta)*a)*(a*a+b*b) + d * wave_to_b;
c = pow(a*a + b*b, mag_power) * mag_amp + mag_zeroPt;
d = clamp( sign(d) * pow( fabs(d) * wave_damp, wave_power ) + a * a_to_wave + b * b_to_wave + c * c_to_wave, wave_clamp_min, wave_clamp_max);
delta_e = laplacian_d * wave_diffusion;
delta_d = e + delta_e;
// f = clamp( pow( (float4)( fabs(f)/history_pow_norm ), (float4)history_pow )*history_pow_norm, history_clamp_min, history_clamp_max );
f = clamp( f, history_clamp_min, history_clamp_max );
delta_f = -f*history_damp + a*a_to_history + b*b_to_history + (1.0-c/c_complement_prediv)*complement_c_to_history + history_diffusion * laplacian_f;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
